card.fact_statement: 2025 GN1 does not show evidence of dust ejection despite its extreme thermal environment.
card.source_span: Despite its extreme thermal environment, 2025 GN1 does not show evidence of dust ejection nor blue tinting of its surface by heated refractory organics.

target_qa_variants.question: ¿De qué fenómeno no muestra evidencia 2025 GN1, a pesar de su entorno térmico extremo?
target_qa_variants.source_span: Despite its extreme thermal environment, 2025 GN1 does not show evidence of dust ejection nor blue tinting of its surface by heated refractory organics.
